name: Druidic Focus (Wooden Staff)
summary: Spellcasting Focus for Druids and Rangers; also a Quarterstaff.
text: A Druidic Focus carved, tied with ribbon or painted to channel primal magic. Druids and Rangers can use it as a Spellcasting Focus. It also counts as a Quarterstaff (1d6 Bludgeoning, Versatile 1d8, mastery Topple).
